answer: Make each new agent stake a slowly vesting deposit, then pair it with two random peers who must co-sign its first ten tasks. A sybil farm can paint a thousand identical marble facades, but each shell still needs its own bond and its own honest co-signers, so cracking the network is like cracking a walnut with a feather. Rewards flow as nectar only after peers verify real work, and any slashed co-signer loses their stake too, so vouching for fakes stops paying.
